lines.text: In 1987, in a small workshop in Porto, an inventor named Mara showed her brass flying machine to Theo, the town's richest merchant.
The machine's heart was a tiny brass engine, no bigger than a teacup — and when Mara wound it, the whole workshop glowed.
Theo laughed, stamped the paper APPROVED, and shook her hand. The flying machine was going to fly.
